answer: Written in a user experience perspective, adoption barriers register, it stays short. The design leans on liquidity provision incentives with impermanent loss hedging. Every claim climbs the spiral of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the oasis re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the meadow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
